description: Browser-fidelity gaps the calibrated Pulp implementation does NOT yet meet (lanes module: lanes/browser_lanes.py). Run with `run --mode calibration`; it stays non-accepting until each gap is fixed.

volatile_allowlist.justification: Chromium settle-loop round counter recorded in DesignIR capture metadata; under host load it varies run to run (13/14/15 observed) while every render, layout and text observation stayed byte-identical. It counts how long the capture waited, not what was captured.

oracle.justification: Skia-vs-Blink glyph rasterization and 1-device-px box-edge rounding, measured with Pulp e41854a (--native-panel-lowering) against Chrome 155.0.8059.39 at channel error > 8; the ceiling is about 1.5x that measurement, so a dropped node, a wrong fill or a missing text run exceeds it.

cases.note: natively lowered : the DesignIR image node keeps src but no asset reference, so the native render leaves a 64x64 hole the browser fills; importer self-check reports 87% similarity and passes
